note: Rows read by hand on each office's own site, by county FIPS. `read` is the day they were read. Only https links to the office's own pages; never a page for one parcel. `property_search_office` and `property_search_url` name the property search as an office's own page gives it (that county's page then shows no directory link). `q` and `a` are the question a row answers, in what the office's page says.

06065.property_search_office: Riverside County Assessor-County Clerk-Recorder, Property Information & Maps

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.office: Riverside County Assessor-County Clerk-Recorder, Recording Services
rows.line: Records deeds and other documents; its records index search lists them, and copies are ordered from the office.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Riverside County?
rows.a: The Riverside County Assessor-County Clerk-Recorder records deeds. Its Recording Services page links to a records index search and to ordering copies of deeds and liens.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Its site reviews and pays property tax bills and keeps the property tax calendar.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Riverside County?
rows.a: The Riverside County Treasurer-Tax Collector collects property tax. Its site reviews and pays a bill and keeps the property tax calendar.

rows.title: Recording courtesy notice
rows.line: Mails homeowners a courtesy notice when a deed, deed of trust or similar document is recorded on their property.

06077.property_search_office: San Joaquin County Assessor, Assessed Value Tool

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.office: San Joaquin County Assessor-Recorder-County Clerk, Recorder
rows.line: The Recorder's page for recorded documents and maps.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in San Joaquin County?
rows.a: The Recorder in the San Joaquin County Assessor-Recorder-County Clerk's office records deeds; its Recorded Documents & Maps page says how to find and copy them.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Secured property tax is paid in two installments, delinquent after 5:00 p.m. on December 10 and April 10.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in San Joaquin County?
rows.a: The San Joaquin County Treasurer-Tax Collector collects property tax. The first installment is delinquent after 5:00 p.m. on December 10 and the second after 5:00 p.m. on April 10.

rows.title: Real estate fraud notice
rows.line: Mails a courtesy notice to the owner on file when a deed, deed of trust or similar document is recorded. No sign-up is needed.

06095.property_search_office: Solano County Assessor/Recorder, Property and Assessment Search

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Its Official Records Search indexes recorded documents by name, date or document number.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Solano County?
rows.a: The Recorder Division of the Solano County Assessor/Recorder records deeds. Its Official Records Search indexes them by name, date or document number.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.office: Solano County Treasurer-Tax Collector-County Clerk, Tax Collector
rows.line: Search and pay property taxes through its online payment system.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Solano County?
rows.a: The Solano County Tax Collector collects property tax; its page links to its online system to search and pay.

rows.title: Recording notification
rows.line: Mails the owner on record a notice when a deed, quitclaim deed or deed of trust is recorded against the property. No sign-up is needed.

06097.property_search_office: Sonoma County Assessor, Search Assessor's Parcel Information

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Its online index covers records from 1964 on; documents are reviewed and bought at its Santa Rosa office.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Sonoma County?
rows.a: The Sonoma County Clerk-Recorder keeps the county's land and finance documents. Its online index covers 1964 on; the documents themselves are reviewed and bought at its Santa Rosa office.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Pay online, by mail, by phone or in person in Santa Rosa.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Sonoma County?
rows.a: The Sonoma County Auditor-Controller-Treasurer-Tax Collector collects property tax online, by mail, by phone or in person at its Santa Rosa office.

12057.property_search_office: Hillsborough County Property Appraiser, Property Search

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.office: Hillsborough County Clerk of Court & Comptroller, Recording
rows.line: The Official Records index from 1965 on can be searched online; certified copies are ordered from the Clerk.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Hillsborough County?
rows.a: The Hillsborough County Clerk of Court & Comptroller records deeds. Its Official Records index from 1965 on can be searched online; certified copies are ordered from the Clerk.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Its property tax page links to the payment center and the real estate tax search.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Hillsborough County?
rows.a: The Hillsborough County Tax Collector collects property tax. Its property tax page links to its payment center and to the real estate tax search.

rows.title: Property Fraud Alert
rows.office: Hillsborough County Clerk of Court & Comptroller
rows.line: Alerts a subscriber when a document is recorded in the county under a person's or business's name they chose. The Clerk charges no fee for it.

12097.property_search_office: Osceola County Property Appraiser, property search

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.office: Osceola County Clerk of the Circuit Court & County Comptroller, Recording
rows.line: Deeds are recorded in the county's Official Records, searchable online at any hour; copies are $1.00 a page.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Osceola County?
rows.a: The Osceola County Clerk's Recording Department records deeds in the county's Official Records, which can be searched online at any hour. Copies are $1.00 a page.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Its real estate taxes page, tax record search and online payments.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Osceola County?
rows.a: The Osceola County Tax Collector collects real estate taxes; its site has a tax record search and online payments.

rows.title: Property Alert Service
rows.office: Osceola County Clerk of the Circuit Court & County Comptroller
rows.line: Emails a subscriber when a recorded document names a parcel ID or party name they registered. The Clerk charges no fee for it.

27123.property_search_office: Ramsey County Property Tax, Records & Election Services, property lookup

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Recorded documents are online through RecordEASE and at its Property Records Resource Center.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Ramsey County?
rows.a: The Ramsey County Recorder's Office keeps the county's official real estate documents. They can be reached online through RecordEASE or at its Property Records Resource Center.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.office: Ramsey County Property Tax, Records & Election Services
rows.line: Its property lookup shows a parcel's values and tax, and pays the tax.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Ramsey County?
rows.a: Ramsey County's Property Tax, Records & Election Services: its property lookup finds a parcel and pays its property tax.

39153.property_search_office: Summit County Fiscal Office, Property Sales Search

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.office: Summit County Fiscal Office, Recording & Property Transfer
rows.line: Its document search finds recorded documents; a mailed copy costs $4, $1 more certified, as Ohio law sets.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Summit County?
rows.a: In Summit County, recorded documents are kept by the Fiscal Office's Recording & Property Transfer section. Its document search finds them; a copy costs $4, as Ohio law sets.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.office: Summit County Fiscal Office, online tax payments
rows.line: Pay a parcel's current installment or all current taxes online from its property search.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Summit County?
rows.a: The Summit County Fiscal Office's online tax payments page explains paying a parcel's current installment or all current taxes from its property search.

rows.title: Parcel map
rows.office: Summit County Fiscal Office, Parcel Viewer
rows.line: The county's map of parcels.

rows.title: Property Record Alert
rows.line: Emails a subscriber about documents recorded under the individual or business names they enter.

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Recorded indices from 1965 on are electronic, with public terminals at the office.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Multnomah County?
rows.a: Multnomah County's Assessment, Recording & Taxation office (DART) records documents. Its recorded indices from 1965 on are electronic, with public terminals at the office.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Payments online, by phone, by mail or in person.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Multnomah County?
rows.a: Multnomah County's Assessment, Recording & Taxation office takes property tax payments online, by phone, by mail or in person.

41051.property_search_office: Multnomah County Assessment, Recording & Taxation, property records websites

42011.property_search_office: Berks County Assessment Office, Property Records Search

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Every document recorded since 1752 is online as an image and index, after registering; copies cost 50 cents a page.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Berks County?
rows.a: The Berks County Recorder of Deeds records the county's deeds and mortgages. Every document it has recorded since 1752 can be searched online after registering; copies cost 50 cents a page.

rows.title: Property Alert fraud protection
rows.line: The Recorder's alert service for property owners about documents recorded in the county.

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: The county's recorder of deeds and official public records. Its online search shows non-certified copies.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Dallas County?
rows.a: The Dallas County Clerk's Recording Division records deeds and keeps the official public records. Its page links to an online search of them, which shows non-certified copies.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Collects property tax. Its page notes penalty and interest on payments made after January 31.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Dallas County?
rows.a: The Dallas County Tax Office, the county's tax assessor-collector, collects property tax. Its page looks up and pays a bill, and notes penalty and interest on payments made after January 31.

rows.title: Property fraud alert
rows.line: An alert about documents recorded in the county, offered with a partner company. The county charges no fee for it.

48113.property_search_office: Dallas Central Appraisal District, Search Appraisals

48157.property_search_office: Fort Bend Central Appraisal District, Property Search

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Deeds, maps, plats and other property records, open to the public; most are online in its Official Public Records search.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Fort Bend County?
rows.a: The Fort Bend County Clerk keeps the county's deeds, maps, plats and other property records. They are open to the public, and most can be searched online in its Official Public Records.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Collects property tax online, by mail or in person.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Fort Bend County?
rows.a: The Fort Bend County Tax Assessor-Collector collects property tax online by card or e-check, by mail or in person at its offices.

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.office: Harris County Clerk, Real Property Department
rows.line: Search real property records by grantor, grantee, date or instrument; images from November 1960. The online copy is not the official record.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Harris County?
rows.a: The Harris County Clerk's Real Property Department keeps the county's real property records. Its online search covers them with images from November 1960; the online copy is not the official record.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Collects property tax: online, by phone, by mail or at a branch. Mailed payments must be postmarked by the last business day in January.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Harris County?
rows.a: The Harris County Tax Office, the county's tax assessor-collector, collects property tax online, by phone, by mail or at its branches. Mailed payments must be postmarked by the last business day in January.

48201.property_search_office: Harris Central Appraisal District, Property Search

rows.title: Recording notification
rows.line: Emails a subscriber whenever a document is recorded with any of up to five names they register. The county charges no fee for it.

53011.property_search_office: Clark County GIS, Property Information Center

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Open to search online or on the office's public computers; copies cost a fee.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Clark County?
rows.a: The Clark County Auditor's recording department keeps the county's recorded real estate documents. Anyone can search them online (e-docs.clark.wa.gov) or on the office's public computers.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Collects property tax. A copy of a tax statement needs the property's identification number.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Clark County?
rows.a: The Clark County Treasurer collects property tax. Its page lists the ways to pay and how to get a copy of a tax statement.

rows.title: Parcel map
rows.line: Parcels and tax lots. The county notes the map is for reference: tax lot lines are not property lines on the ground.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.line: Search permits by address or permit number. Almost all of its records are for parcels in unincorporated Clark County.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Clark County?
rows.a: Clark County Community Development's permit status page searches its permits by address, permit number or contractor. Almost all of its records are for parcels in unincorporated Clark County.

rows.title: Recording notification
rows.line: Emails a subscriber each time a land record document is recorded under a name or parcel number they chose.

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Records real estate deeds and mortgages; its page links to the online records search.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in King County?
rows.a: The King County Recorder's Office records real estate deeds and mortgages. Its page links to an online search of recorded documents.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Collects property tax: online, by mail or in person. The halves are due April 30 and October 31.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in King County?
rows.a: King County Treasury Operations collects property tax. Its page lists paying online, by mail or in person, and a parcel lookup for an account.

rows.title: Recording Activity Notification System
rows.line: Emails a subscriber each time a land records document is recorded with a name they chose.

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Its public records search covers recorded documents, land records and survey maps.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Kitsap County?
rows.a: The Kitsap County Auditor's Recording Division records deeds. Its page links to a public records search of recorded documents and land records.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Statements are mailed in February; the halves are due April 30 and October 31.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Kitsap County?
rows.a: The Kitsap County Treasurer's page links to paying property tax online and to each parcel's tax statement. Statements are mailed in February.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: Kitsap County Department of Community Development
rows.line: Its permit records cover unincorporated Kitsap County, with a search of historical permits and the Online Permit Center.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Kitsap County?
rows.a: The Kitsap County Department of Community Development keeps building, land use and site permits for unincorporated Kitsap County. Its records page links to its permit searches.

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Deeds, easements, mortgage documents and more are indexed online with their images; certified copies can be bought online.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Pierce County?
rows.a: The Pierce County Auditor's Office records deeds and other property documents. Its Recorded Documents page links to the online search, where deeds, easements and mortgage documents show with their images.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Statements are mailed in February. A bill over $50 can be paid in two halves, by April 30 and October 31.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Pierce County?
rows.a: The Pierce County Assessor-Treasurer's Tax Bills & Payments page lists the ways to pay: online, by mail, by phone or in person. Statements are mailed in February.

rows.title: Parcel map
rows.office: Pierce County Planning & Public Works, Public GIS
rows.line: The county's interactive map of parcels.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.line: Search applications and permits by application or permit number.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Pierce County?
rows.a: Pierce County Planning & Public Works keeps building applications and permits; its online permits website (PALS) searches them by application or permit number.

rows.title: Owner Alert
rows.line: Emails a subscriber any time a document is recorded under their name. The county charges no fee for it.

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Documents from 1973 on are in its current document search; earlier ones are in its historic search.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Skagit County?
rows.a: The Skagit County Auditor's Recording Department records documents. Its page links to the current document search (1973 on) and the historic search for earlier documents.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Collects property tax. The halves are due April 30 and October 31; a tax under $50 is due in full by April 30.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Skagit County?
rows.a: The Skagit County Treasurer collects property tax. Its page lists paying online, by phone, by mail or in person, and the due dates of April 30 and October 31.

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Most documents recorded since July 1976 are online; earlier ones are on microfilm at the office.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Snohomish County?
rows.a: The Snohomish County Auditor's Recording Division records documents. Most recorded since July 1976 can be searched online; earlier ones are on microfilm at its office.

rows.title: Recorded document notification
rows.line: Emails a subscriber when a document is recorded in their name or for their property. The county charges no fee for it.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Property taxes are due by April 30 and October 31.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Walla Walla County?
rows.a: The Walla Walla County Treasurer's payment center lists paying by phone, online, by mail or in person. Property taxes are due by April 30 and October 31.
